• Buildmesh needs your decision about its staging PR connection.

Buildmesh opens its staging PRs through a connected Bitbucket account.
Which account should it use?

› 1. Reconnect as me (Recommended)
     Reconnect the staging repo's Bitbucket connection with your own account.
     You complete browser consent; the agent handles the rest.

  2. Ask the account owner to exclude them
     Keep the connection and exclude the staging branches from the other merge flow.

  3. Dedicated bot account
     Connect a separate Bitbucket bot/service account for Buildmesh.
     Someone must create the account and grant repository access.

  4. Type something.
